name: Liang Wei
thesis: Interfacial degradation mechanisms in solid-state lithium-metal batteries probed by operando spectroscopy
transitionSignals: Filed first patent on electrolyte coatings
description: Liang designs solid electrolytes that suppress dendrite formation, with prototype cells reaching 400 cycles at high current density. His blend of fundamental electrochemistry and hands-on cell fabrication makes him a strong fit for an energy-storage R&D team.
